decisions.reason: As a close adjacent service with no clear failure signal yet, management would likely preserve the option for another year, although conferencing is competitive and less tied to the firm's infrastructure advantage.
This product fits the firm's metro fibre and data-centre strengths and already shows concrete adoption, so the option looks valuable and worth retaining.
Optical spectrum connectivity is strongly aligned with the firm's high-bandwidth strategic direction and owned-network capabilities, so management would be unlikely to withdraw it this early.
A digital ordering portal is inexpensive to carry, supports software-defined service delivery, and still has upside while market acceptance is being learned.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy voice offering with weak fit to the firm's forward-looking software-defined infrastructure strategy, so its option value is likely too low to justify continued attention.

Direct voice network connection still complements the enterprise voice base and network business, so management would likely keep it for now despite the mature and slower-growth nature of voice services.
